dwigraha.note: Two grahas occupying one sign, and what the verse says of the native. Read from N. Chidambaram Iyer's 1885 translation; Mantreswara gives the same twenty-one readings at Phaladeepika ch. 18 vv. 1 to 5. The chapter closes by saying that three or more together are read as the pairs they contain, which is what one rule a pair does of itself.

Chidambaram Iyer's 1885 translation of Brihat Jataka ch. 14, which prints these lists from Jataka Parijata; they run in strict combinatorial order, the Sun first, so a rule's grahas are generated and only its reading is data.
